hero.title:
We train, we teach,
we plant — and we count every result.
hero.subtitle: EmpowerKids–South Sudan works with schools, smallholder farmers and young people across three states. Every figure on this page comes from our own field records, and every one of them is open to verification.

about.heading:
Verified impact.
Radical transparency.
about.description1: EmpowerKids–South Sudan is a non‑governmental organisation registered under the NGO Act 2016 (RRC Reg. No. 169). Founded in 2014, we operate in Juba, Central Equatoria State. Our Juba Demonstration Farm is located at Juba 2, Gumbo‑Sherikat Area. Our programmes span education, agriculture, youth empowerment, and civic voice. Our work is validated by CAF America, allowing US donors to give tax‑deductibly.
about.description2: Every figure on this page is taken directly from our programme monitoring records. Funders and evaluators can request the underlying data at any time — we have nothing to hide.

featuredProject.label: Featured Programme
featuredProject.title: Empower Farmers South Sudan 🌱
featuredProject.description: Using Foundations for Farming conservation agriculture on our 50×100 m demonstration farm in Gumbo‑Sherikat (Juba 2). Our 21‑person field team has trained 75 smallholder farmers this year (129 total), and we've harvested 472.44 kg of maize from just 0.132 ha — proof that climate‑smart farming works.
bullets: 75 farmers trained this year (129 total) in Biliny, Bajur, Dumandong & Mangala

items.title: Successful Maize Harvest at Juba Demonstration Farm
